statement_text: Domain Objectはclass化自体を目的にせず、identity/invariant/lifecycle/authorityがないpayloadをEntity/Aggregateへ昇格しない。Value Objectはimmutable、Aggregate更新はroot境界内transaction、Queryはside-effectなし、Domain Eventは完了事実の過去形、domainはPortを介してAdapterへ依存する。`Manager/Helper/Util/Data`等の責務不明名を根拠なしで許さず、testはprivate実装名でなくdomain object＋operation＋oracle IDへbindする。
source_atom_digest_rule: SHA-256 of UTF-8 "HIL-NFR-25 " + statement semantic digest without sha256: prefix + LF. One IR identity atom only.

conditions.text: Do not promote a payload to Entity/Aggregate without identity, invariant, lifecycle, and authority grounds; class creation is not an end.
Aggregate updates occur within the Aggregate root transaction boundary.
Domain Event expresses a completed fact in past tense.
Domain depends on Adapter through a Port.

excluded_conditions.text: Reject unsupported responsibility-ambiguous names such as Manager/Helper/Util/Data.
excluded_conditions.handled_by: HARNESS-L2/L11-048 adopted for exact revisions by po-decision-2026-09-29-11candidates.md row 28; not duplicated in 083.

excluded_conditions.text: Bind tests to domain object + operation + oracle ID rather than private implementation names.
